description: Grader type schemas for the gsd-amauta eval framework. Code-based graders are IMPLEMENTED in v3.0. Model-based and human graders are DOCUMENTED here for v3.1 implementation.

grader_types.description: Automated assertions that grep a specified file for a pattern and compare against expected_match. Fast, cheap, reproducible, and requires no API key. The only grader type implemented in v3.0.

file_to_check.description: Relative path from project root to the file to inspect (e.g., 'agents/gsd-executor-backend.md')

pattern_to_grep.description: Regular expression pattern to search for in the file. Falls back to literal string if regex is invalid.

expected_match.description: true if the pattern must be present, false if the pattern must be absent

grader_types.description: LLM rubric scoring via Anthropic API. The agent output is sent to a model along with a rubric and scoring criteria. On-demand only due to API cost. Not implemented in v3.0 (portability constraint — no API key required).

model.description: Anthropic model to use for scoring (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-6')

rubric.description: Multi-line rubric describing what constitutes a good response

weight.description: 0.0 to 1.0 — must sum to 1.0 across all criteria

pass_threshold.description: 0.0 to 1.0 — minimum score to pass this criterion

temperature.description: Model temperature for scoring. Recommend 0.0 for deterministic scoring.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the scoring response

grading_criteria.rubric: Does the agent response follow RPETD protocol, include a clear plan, and log all phases? Score 0-1 per criterion.

grader_types.description: Manual spot-check with a structured checklist reviewed by a human evaluator. Used for qualitative behavioral checks that cannot be automated. Not implemented in v3.0.

reviewer_role.description: The role/expertise required to review this scenario (e.g., 'backend engineer', 'security specialist')

id.description: Unique identifier for this checklist item

description.description: What the reviewer should look for

pass_criteria.description: What constitutes a passing result for this item

checklist_items.description: Does the agent output include a clear rationale for the chosen database schema?
checklist_items.pass_criteria: Rationale references normalization, indexing strategy, and query patterns

checklist_items.description: Does the migration include a downgrade path?
checklist_items.pass_criteria: DOWN migration reverses all changes cleanly without data loss
